notes.title: [dev blog] The Sound of Progress
notes.content:
[for previous posts, [url=https://www.dgs-game-studio.com/blog.html]visit the website[/url]]	
[b]The Sound of Progress[/b] [u]CrazyAmphibian - 16/dec/2023[/u]	

	last blog post i messed up putting it on steam. oops. this one should be good, i hope.		[h3]Happy holidays![/h3]	
	it's that time of the year again, when snow doesn't fall for another 2 months but we tell ourselves it'll be a white christmas. Except for you on the southern hemisphere, who are burning up in summer heat.
	what better way to celebrate than to have a blog post!

	[i]"tronslat hardh"
	-Elo
[/i]	
			[h3]SSTD news![/h3]	
		I've been putting work back into SSTD, getting a content bundle ready for release. It's nearly done.
		It'll release some time next week, just before the winter sale.
		For those of you with the game, prepare yourselves for a nice burst of content!
		For those who've yet to buy, perhaps the deal is that much more enticing...
		
		Either way, progress is progress.
		here's a sneak peek at what the next update will have to offer:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679167/77291b1e50afaea5b83d6c47f64a796aed43c842.png[/img]
		looks like hell, huh? good!	
	
	[h3]CM is still going[/h3]	
		This new project has been a bit slow to kick off, at least to me. You might say that it's a bit ambitious for my skill levels, but i say i'll make it work regardless.
		Most of the changes have been back-end system changes, and not a whole lot of "visible" content, so sorry to say,  but no more teasers for this project with this post.
		I feel like progress will pick up soon enough, but now i've hit the part where i'll need to be of a creative mind, not a programming mind.
		Still, i'll make it work. Hopefully well, even!

notes.title: V 1.3 "SPEED"
notes.content:
once again, more performance improvements and bugfixes. I swear i'm a competent dev!
[list]
[*]fixed bug with debug info not properly showing on the final level
[*]changed object spawning code to be more performant
[list][*]most noticeable during the last level. this helps, though the sheer number of things rendering does still hurt performance.[/list]
[*]fixed not being able to shift-click a spell into a gem sometimes
[list][*]this one was a massive pain in the a** to figure out[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2 "Few more bugs - and changes" released
notes.content:
this version adds a new setting and fixes some stuff, and a singular balance change (how daring)
[list]
[*]hit radius display now actually shows the correct size.
[*]added an option for the amount of hit radius visualizers. 0-2, default 1.
[list][*]helps solves performance problems with many spells, as less objects will be spawned.[/list]
[*]reduced focus fire's speed bonus x3 -> x2
[list][*]massive speed was never the goal, makes an achievment too easy to get. still makes it fast, though.[/list]
[*]updated localization files
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 out now
notes.content:
not even a day and there's bug fixes, figures.
CHANGES:
[list]
[*]Minor UI performance increases
[*]Improved performance of main game logic (spell targeting, gem stat calculations, and more)
[*]Fixed bug with the in-level picking spell menu not laying out correctly
[*]custom gem creation now factors in capacity cost reduction into it's calculations both displayed and the slider.
[/list]
View the previous changes on the [url=https://dgs-game-studio.com/games/SSTD/changelog.html]official website changelog[/url].
